verdict.rationale: CoreWeave's docs index lists a first-party "Mission Control MCP server" for investigating your environment and making supported changes, so an official MCP server exists. The evidence is a single one-line mention: it does not document how an agent connects, what tools are exposed, or how authentication works. missing for 10: connection/setup documentation (endpoint, transport, auth), documented tool list and scope of supported changes, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Mission Control Agent and the Mission Control MCP server for investigating your environment and making supported changes.
